يعتدل (form VIII)
# يَعْتَدِلُ (yaʕtadilu) /jaʕ.ta.di.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# يَعْتَدِلَ (yaʕtadila) /jaʕ.ta.di.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# يَعْتَدِلْ (yaʕtadil) /jaʕ.ta.dil/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
